I have implemented the `libswscale` image scaling and pixel-format conversion library in Zig in [`/app/swscale-impl/src/main.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig) (built via [`/app/swscale-impl/build.zig`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/build.zig) into `libswscale_candidate.so`).

### Key Implementation Highlights
- **C-ABI & Filter Initialization**: Implemented [`swscale_create`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L3055-L3063), [`swscale_process`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L3065-L3076), and [`swscale_destroy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L3078-L3086) along with 1D horizontal/vertical filter bank generation ([`initFilter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L152-L387)) for `SWS_POINT`, `SWS_BILINEAR`, and `SWS_BICUBIC` matching FFmpeg's fixed-point filter mathematics and chroma siting.
- **Portable `@Vector` SIMD Fast Paths**:
  - **Same-size RGB/BGR/RGBA/BGRA/GRAY8 conversions**: 16-pixel wide SIMD byte-shuffle deinterleaving and interleaving ([`loadRgb24_16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L791-L808), [`storeRgb24_16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L440-L456), [`storeRgba32_16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L458-L473)) and 32-bit fixed-point BT.601 RGB-to-Y ([`rgb16ToY16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L816-L832)) and RGB-to-UV ([`rgb16ToUv16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L834-L853)).
  - **Same-size YUV-to-RGB (`YUV420P`, `YUV422P`, `YUV444P`, `NV12`, `NV21`)**: 32-pixel wide 16-bit high-multiply (`vpmulhuw` via [`mulhuw16`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L426-L430) and [`YuvMulConsts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L405-L424)) inside [`convertYuv420pToRgb`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L530-L693) and [`convertYuv422pToRgb`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L695-L788).
  - **2-PassSeparable Scaling Pipeline**: Ring-buffered horizontal + vertical scaling ([`scalePlane`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L1943-L2024), [`scalePackedRgbToRgb`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L2400-L2568), [`scaleYuvToRgb`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L2157-L2369), [`scaleRgbToYuv`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L2612-L2875)) with specialized SIMD kernels for 1-tap, 2-tap, 4-tap, and 5-tap horizontal/vertical filters ([`hScale8To15`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L1562-L1764), [`hScale16To15`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L1766-L1941), [`vScaleLine`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-syoom452/swscale-impl/src/main.zig#L2026-L2084)).

### Verification & Performance Results
- **Contract Accuracy (`/app/perf-check --contract --quick`)**: **58/58 conversions pass** within the required PSNR bars (49/58 bit-exact at `100.0 dB`, minimum same-size PSNR `69.3 dB` vs `60 dB` bar, minimum scaled PSNR `68.8 dB` vs `40 dB` bar).
- **Benchmark Speedup (`/app/perf-check`)**: **4.64x geometric mean speedup** across all 10 benchmark workloads:

| Workload | Reference | Candidate | Speedup |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `yuv420p->rgb24 1920x1080 bilinear` | 7,661,778 | 3,534,165 | **2.17x** |
| `rgb24->yuv420p 1920x1080 bilinear` | 96,109,669 | 9,671,288 | **9.94x** |
| `rgb24->bgra 1920x1080 bilinear` | 8,564,288 | 1,572,113 | **5.45x** |
| `rgb24->nv12 1920x1080 bilinear` | 92,913,464 | 9,731,217 | **9.55x** |
| `rgba->rgb24 3840x2160 bilinear` | 30,109,204 | 5,587,027 | **5.39x** |
| `yuv420p->rgb24 3840x2160->1920x1080 bilinear` | 156,220,155 | 37,219,805 | **4.20x** |
| `rgb24->rgb24 1920x1080->3840x2160 bilinear` | 411,094,644 | 98,494,257 | **4.17x** |
| `rgb24->yuv420p 1920x1080->640x360 bilinear` | 69,336,358 | 23,687,427 | **2.93x** |
| `rgb24->rgb24 1920x1080->640x360 nearest` | 20,150,206 | 6,387,700 | **3.15x** |
| `rgb24->rgb24 1280x720->1920x1080 bicubic` | 208,328,502 | 44,206,548 | **4.71x** |
